title: Typing State
description: Learn how to type useState and useReducer hooks.

data.text: TypeScript can infer state types from initial values, but sometimes you need explicit types for complex state.

data.title: Typed useState
Typed useReducer
Discriminated Unions
data.text: The action type in useReducer uses a discriminated union - each action has a 'type' field that TypeScript uses to narrow the type.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: TypeScript infers state types from initial values
Use explicit types for null or union initial values
useReducer uses discriminated unions for actions
data.takeaway: Well-typed state prevents bugs and improves developer experience.
